messages:
emily: who's up for a Sunday morning 'Board Game Brunch + Mimosas' at the office kitchen? thinking 11am so it's not too early.
raj: YES. will bring a box of croissants.
tom: in. i can bring Settlers or Codenames if people want.
nina: love. any non-alc mimosa options? im driving that day.
emily: good call, will bring sparkling water + orange + a non-alc bottle.
oliver: can also bring a small portable coffee urn. will that be too much?
emily: never too much coffee. :)
mari: Facilities note: kitchen space is fine but please request table setup. i'll reserve 10:30-1:00 and bring extra chairs if needed. noise ok until 1pm.
tom: thanks @mari. if we do games, maybe have a quick rotation sign-up so people can hop in/out.
raj: i'll make a tiny sign-up poll in the thread: 11-12 casual games, 12-1 chill/lounge. react with :one: or :two:.
nina: :one: (games)
tom: :one:
oliver: :two: chill, might have kid pickup later
emily: :one: or both if that helps with numbers.
mari: reservation done. also pinging cleanup crew: please put food waste in compost bin.
emily: labeling alert: raj, any nut-containing pastries?
raj: some croissants have almond filling. i'll bring a nut-free option too and label both.
tom: bringing Codenames (no pieces to lose) + a small travel chess set. any requests?
nina: can we do a short voting for table games? favorite win gets a tiny prize (like a bagel coupon).
emily: love a bagel coupon. i'll pick up a small stash of stickers as 'prizes'.
raj: heads up: street fair on Sunday could affect parking. recommend transit.
oliver: noted. i'll carpool with tom.
emily: thanks all. i'll create calendar invite and include co-hosts (raj + tom). see you Sunday 11am 37a37a :game_die:
